about: Screen rows lost (#171, QA 1.54.0 LOW-4, NIT-2): a busy master, one that hangs up, and a reply past the master's cap (its kept tail starts inside a row: that row, x/y#78, is dropped, the rest read) make the answer incomplete: --json complete false with why range, --ref partial with why range. A screen read slower than --ref's light budget ends at the budget (why budget); --json and --ref --full wait up to 2 s and read it whole
